place: 人民大會堂・天安門廣場

title.zh: 胡耀邦追悼大會；廣場上的學生聽廣播
title.en: Hu Yaobang's state memorial; students listen outside

summary.zh: 4 月 22 日上午，胡耀邦追悼大會在人民大會堂舉行，約四十分鐘，全國電視直播。廣場上的學生肅立收聽。大會堂前有數排警察與士兵。廣場上用喇叭轉播一事見於 Wikipedia（「broadcast live to the students」）與二手整理。
summary.en: On 22 April the c. 40-minute memorial was held inside the Great Hall and televised nationally; the students in the Square stood in silence. Rows of police and soldiers lined the Great Hall.
